text: The dining table is still set, but the court has recorded your earlier answer. Amelia and Bernard's service stations remain visible, and the party can use the hall as a route rather than repeating the same reaction.

views.text: The empty courses have left rings on the oak. The two child servers keep their hands close to their own pockets, where family tokens might be hidden.
The feast appears untouched and welcoming. The servers bow with courtly precision, as if your last visit was a toast rather than a confrontation.
